name: Workflow Bands
prompt: High-fidelity desktop healthcare operations UI composition at 1440 x 900. Clinic software only, not the mentoring portal. Clinical Wayfinding Ledger direction: clean, precise, low-ornament and calm, using a white workspace, cool off-white canvas, deep-sage interaction color, dark slate-green text, quiet gray-green borders, no gradients, no glass, no decorative illustration, no oversized metric cards, and no ornamental shadows. Show Northfield Clinic and a Tracking Board with compact clinic context, visible snapshot freshness and partial-state language, stable filters with counts, and three aligned horizontal workflow bands: Before arrival, In clinic, and Provider work. Each band uses the same table grammar and preserves the reading order of patient, operational status and timing, location or owner, recorded context, and explicit next action. Use 16px primary text, 14px secondary text, tabular numerals, sentence case, restrained status tags, and generous but efficient spacing. Late is schedule timing rather than clinical priority; unknown and unrecorded remain explicit; no red/green acuity ladder. Option B: Workflow Bands, stronger wayfinding and stage scanning while retaining ledger-like comparison.
